summary_en: This study combines mesoscopic photoacoustic imaging and multispectral optoacoustic tomography to measure early vascular and oxygenation responses to radiotherapy in two human breast-cancer xenograft models. The multi-scale measurements reveal treatment- and model-dependent changes before conventional tumor-size endpoints, supporting photoacoustic biomarkers for early therapy-response assessment.

summary_en: The study uses multispectral optoacoustic imaging to measure placental oxygen saturation and adaptation to maternal hypoxia in a STOX1A mouse model of preeclampsia. Despite the disease phenotype, baseline placental oxygenation and hypoxia-response capacity were preserved, demonstrating a noninvasive functional-imaging application for placental physiology.

summary_en: This work combines an eight-linear-array half-ring PACT system with an encoder-decoder network trained on paired single-finger measurements. The learned enhancement generalizes to large-field human-hand imaging, improving vessel clarity and contrast while mitigating optical shadowing and array-misalignment artifacts that arise when scaling the aperture.
